name: Azure for Students
summary: US$100 of Azure cloud credit plus free services, with no credit card.
key: US$100 credit to use within 12 months. No credit card required.
who: Full-time university students, signing up with a school email.
how: Sign up with your school email.
Renew each year while you are a student.
catches: When the credit runs out, Microsoft asks you to move to pay-as-you-go. If you don't, your subscription is disabled.
